source_audit.chat_factory: utils/llm_client/factory.py constructs one client from one resolved model/base_url/api_key tuple
source_audit.sdk_retries: OpenAI/Anthropic max_retries are attached to that same client; no error-driven cross-provider failover was found in the shared factory
source_audit.config_resolution: ConfigManager resolves each tier to one concrete endpoint before request creation
source_audit.caveat: N.E.K.O supports runtime configuration changes, so preflight alone does not yet prove an in-flight hot switch cannot race a request.

negative_probe.mutation: temporary isolated core_config with assistApi=free and coreApi=free

acceptance_support.provider_privacy: resolved endpoint allowlist preflight is implemented and catches N.E.K.O free-relay fallback across all enabled model tiers

caveats: The allowlist is a XiaoYu owner policy, not a claim that all listed first-party vendors have identical privacy terms.
The current gate protects configuration/startup validation. Runtime provider hot-switch race closure remains pending.
No N.E.K.O core patch is introduced by this gate.
